messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function walmart_purchase with loc "聖荷西" (San Jose) and product_list ["蘋果", "米飯", "瓶裝水"]? But also pack_size for water: 12 cans. The function signature: product_list: string[], pack_size?: number[]. The size of array should equal product_list. So we need to provide pack_size array same length as product_list. For items without pack size, maybe null or 0? The default is not use it if not specified. So we can omit pack_size entirely? But the function signature says optional. So we can just not include pack_size. But the user wants 12 cans of bottled water. That might be pack_size for water. So we need to provide pack_size array: [null, null, 12]? But the type is number[]. So we can't have null. Maybe we can set pack_size: [0,0,12] or [1,1,12]? But the default is not use it if not specified. So we can provide pack_size: [1,1,12] meaning 1 apple, 1 rice, 12 water. But the user didn't specify quantity for apples and rice. So maybe we can set pack_size: [1,1,12]. That seems fine.

Thus call function:

{
  "loc": "聖荷西",
  "product_list": ["蘋果", "米飯", "瓶裝水"],
  "pack_size": [1,1,12]
}

Let's do that.
